description: Redux reducer module for managing search-related state in Mattermost, including search results, pinned posts, flagged posts, current searches, and related flags.

methods.name: results
methods.description: Reducer for managing search result post IDs, handling search results, post removal, and clearing on logout.

methods.name: fileResults
methods.description: Reducer for managing search result file IDs, handling search results, file removal, and clearing on logout.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Reducer for mapping post IDs to matched words, handling search results, post removal, and clearing on logout.

methods.name: flagged
methods.description: Reducer for flagged post IDs, handling flagged posts, preference updates, post removal, and clearing on logout.

methods.name: removePinnedPost
methods.description: Helper function to remove a pinned post from state.

methods.name: pinned
methods.description: Reducer for pinned posts per channel, handling pinned post updates, deletions, and logout.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Reducer for current search parameters per team, handling search term updates and logout.

methods.name: isSearchingTerm
methods.description: Reducer for boolean indicating if initial search is in progress.

methods.name: isSearchGettingMore
methods.description: Reducer for boolean indicating if more search results are being fetched.

methods.name: isLimitedResults
methods.description: Reducer for tracking if search results are limited/inaccessible.

methods.name: truncationInfo
methods.description: Reducer for tracking truncation info for posts and files.
